reason: The frozen 64 MiB finite stream contract is directly compatible with NIST STS and PractRand. Standard TestU01 SmallCrush/Crush consume more data than one 64 MiB finite stream; repeating/cycling the stream would invalidate the experiment. TestU01 is therefore moved to a descriptive deterministic-continuation subprogram before any STAT-01 data are acquired.
